shared_elements: low-relief carving of a scene with figures
raised arms / gesture of arms extended forward
register-like division of the surface (figural zone above, other content below)
sun-disc with radiating rays (A) vs. radiating spoked wheel (B) — only loosely comparable
justification: Both surfaces show human figures in profile carved in low relief with arms extended and headgear, but the specific subjects diverge entirely: A is an arch-topped stela dominated by dense columns and rows of script beneath a small worship scene of figures with upraised arms beneath a rayed disc, while B is a purely pictorial military scene of horses, a chariot with a spoked wheel, archers/warriors with bows and reins, above a marsh or water band. No shared distinctive motif, no shared relationship (adoration vs. chariot-driving), and no shared compositional scheme (text-dominated stela vs. full-field narrative).
